description_en: Queries published delivery groups and their application information for a specified product type under the current Alibaba Cloud account by using paging. Supports filtering by delivery group, application, and user authorization status
description_zh: 分页查询当前阿里云账号下指定产品类型的已发布交付组及其应用信息，支持按交付组、应用和用户授权情况筛选
name: ListPublishedAppInstanceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The product type. This parameter is required. The value must match the product type of the delivery groups you want to query. Only published delivery groups of the specified product type are returned. A parameter error is returned if an unrecognized value is passed in.

Valid values:

`CloudApp`: WUYING Cloud Application.
`CloudBrowser`: Cloud Browser.
`WuyingServer`: Enterprise Workstation.
`WuyingWorkstation`: Personal Edition Lingjou Container Workstation.
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`: Team Edition Lingjou Container Workstation.
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`: Dedicated Edition Lingjou Container Workstation.
`AndroidCloud`: Cloud Phone.
`AIAgent`: AgentBay (AI agent)
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型，必填。取值需与要查询的交付组所属产品类型一致，只返回该产品类型下的已发布交付组；传入无法识别的取值时返回参数错误。

取值：

`CloudApp`：无影云应用。
`CloudBrowser`：云浏览器。
`WuyingServer`：企业版工作站。
`WuyingWorkstation`：个人版灵构容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`：灵构团队版容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`：灵构专属版容器工作站。
`AndroidCloud`：云手机。
`AIAgent`：AgentBay（AI 智能体）
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. This parameter is required. Start from page `1` and use this parameter together with `PageSize`. Keep other filter conditions unchanged when querying subsequent pages
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，必填。请从第 `1` 页开始查询，并与 `PageSize` 配合使用；查询后续页时保持其他筛选条件不变
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of delivery groups to return per page. This parameter is required. Valid values: `1` to `100`. Unit: delivery groups. Specify this value explicitly and do not rely on default values from other query operations
parameters.help_zh: 每页最多返回的交付组数量，必填。取值范围为 `1`～`100`，单位为个交付组。请显式指定，不要沿用其他查询接口的默认值
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The delivery group ID used for filtering. Substring matching is supported. You can pass in a full ID or a consecutive segment of the ID. If this parameter is not specified or is set to an empty string, no filtering by ID is applied. This parameter can be used together with other filter conditions. Results must satisfy all conditions simultaneously
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选的交付组 ID，支持包含匹配。可传入完整 ID 或其中的连续片段；不传或为空字符串时不按 ID 筛选。可与其他筛选条件同时使用，结果须同时满足所有条件
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The delivery group name used for filtering. Substring matching is supported. For example, if you pass in `OfficeApps`, delivery groups whose names contain this text are matched. If this parameter is not specified or is set to an empty string, no filtering by name is applied. When specified together with the delivery group ID, both the ID and name must match
parameters.help_zh: 用于筛选的交付组名称，支持包含匹配。例如传入 `办公应用`，可匹配名称中包含该文本的交付组。不传或为空字符串时不按名称筛选；与交付组 ID 同时传入时，须同时匹配 ID 和名称
parameters.name: app_instance_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The username to exclude based on existing authorization. Exact username matching is used, for example, `alice`. When specified, delivery groups in which all applications have been directly authorized to this user are excluded. If this parameter is not specified or is set to an empty string, no exclusion based on user authorization is applied.

Authorization granted for individual applications only, or access permissions obtained through user groups, is not fully evaluated by this condition. Do not treat the returned results as a complete list of delivery groups that the user has no access permissions to
parameters.help_zh:
需要排除已有授权的用户名，按完整用户名匹配，例如 `alice`。传入后，排除已直接向该用户授权全部应用的交付组；不传或为空字符串时，不按用户授权情况排除。

仅按单个应用授权、或通过用户组获得的访问权限，不由本条件完整判断。 不能据此把返回结果等同于该用户完全无权访问的交付组列表
parameters.name: exclude_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The application ID used for filtering delivery groups. Substring matching is supported. The delivery group must contain a deployed application that matches the condition. If this parameter is not specified or is set to an empty string, no filtering by application ID is applied. When specified together with `AppName`, the same application must satisfy both conditions.

This condition does not trim the returned `Apps` list
parameters.help_zh:
用于筛选交付组的应用 ID，支持包含匹配。交付组中须存在符合条件的已部署应用。不传或为空字符串时不按应用 ID 筛选；与 `AppName` 同时传入时，须由同一应用同时满足。

该条件不会裁剪返回的 `Apps` 列表
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en:
The application name used for filtering delivery groups. Substring matching is supported. The delivery group must contain a deployed application whose name includes the specified text. If this parameter is not specified or is set to an empty string, no filtering by application name is applied. When specified together with `AppId`, the same application must satisfy both conditions.

This condition does not trim the returned `Apps` list
parameters.help_zh:
用于筛选交付组的应用名称，支持包含匹配。交付组中须存在名称包含指定文本的已部署应用。不传或为空字符串时不按应用名称筛选；与 `AppId` 同时传入时，须由同一应用同时满足。

该条件不会裁剪返回的 `Apps` 列表
parameters.name: app_name

schema.description_en: The result of this paging query, including the request ID, paging information, total number of matching delivery groups, and the delivery group list for the current page
schema.description_zh: 本次分页查询的结果，包括请求 ID、分页信息、匹配交付组总数和当前页交付组列表

AppInstanceGroupModels.description_en: The list of published delivery groups on the current page, sorted by creation time from newest to oldest. An empty list is returned if no results match or if the requested page exceeds the result range
AppInstanceGroupModels.description_zh: 当前页的已发布交付组列表，按创建时间从新到旧排序。没有匹配结果或请求页超出结果范围时，返回空列表

items.description_en: A published delivery group and the deployed application information in its image
items.description_zh: 一个已发布交付组及其镜像中的已部署应用信息

Apps.description_en: The list of deployed applications in the delivery group image. The `AppId` and `AppName` parameters in the request only determine whether a delivery group is included in the results. They do not trim this list to only the matched applications
Apps.description_zh: 该交付组镜像中的已部署应用列表。请求中的 `AppId`、`AppName` 仅决定交付组是否入选，不会将本列表裁剪为匹配的应用

items.description_en: The identifier, name, version, and icon information of a deployed application
items.description_zh: 一个已部署应用的标识、名称、版本及图标信息

ExpiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the delivery group. For delivery groups sold as resources, this is the resource expiration time. For other delivery groups, this is the delivery group expiration time. The value is in ISO 8601 format with milliseconds and a time zone offset. The returned time zone offset is +00:00. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSS+HH:mm
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 交付组的到期时间。按资源售卖的交付组返回其资源的到期时间，其他交付组返回交付组自身的到期时间。ISO 8601 日期时间格式，包含毫秒和时区偏移，返回的时区偏移为 +00:00。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSS+HH:mm

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the delivery group. The value is in ISO 8601 format with milliseconds and a time zone offset. The returned time zone offset is +00:00. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSS+HH:mm
GmtCreate.description_zh: 交付组的创建时间。ISO 8601 日期时间格式，包含毫秒和时区偏移，返回的时区偏移为 +00:00。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSS+HH:mm

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the delivery group
RegionId.description_zh: 交付组所属的地域 ID

Status.description_en:
The delivery group status. This operation returns delivery groups only in the following status:

`PUBLISHED`: Published and listed. The delivery group can appear in the query results of this operation. This status does not indicate that a specified user has been granted access permissions
Status.description_zh:
交付组状态。本接口只返回以下状态的交付组：

`PUBLISHED`：已发布并已上架，可进入本接口的查询结果。该状态不表示指定用户已获得访问权限

PageNumber.description_en: The page number specified in this request
PageNumber.description_zh: 本次请求指定的查询页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of delivery groups per page specified in the request. Unit: delivery groups. This value does not represent the actual number of delivery groups returned on the current page. The actual number on the current page may be less than this value
PageSize.description_zh: 请求指定的每页交付组数量，单位为个。该值不表示当前页实际返回数量；当前页实际数量可能小于该值

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use this ID to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位请求问题

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of delivery groups that match all filter conditions. Unit: delivery groups. This value is not the number of delivery groups returned on the current page. Each delivery group is counted only once. The value is `0` if no results match
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合全部筛选条件的交付组总数，单位为个。该值不是当前页返回数量，同一交付组只计一次；没有匹配结果时为 `0`
